repos.description: 👾 Fast and simple video download library and CLI tool written in Go
A cli tool to download private videos on vimeo. Written in golang.

⬇️ A simple all-in-one CLI tool to download EVERYTHING from a URL (like youtube-dl/yt-dlp, forum-dl, gallery-dl, simpler ArchiveBox). 🎭 Uses headless Chrome to get HTML, JS, CSS, images/video/audio/subtitles, PDFs, screenshots, article text, git repos, and more...

findings.value: curl -s $URL | jq '[.video[] | {id, height, width, codecs}] | sort_by(.height)'
